item.title: 【Helpdesk】Set correct colors for ProRes masters in MPC-HC (x64)
item.description:
Hello everyone,
After fixing the color issue when playing ProRes masters in VLC, I wanted to fix the same video renderer issue in MPC-HC as well.

With MPC-HC, the shadows and the overall image of the ProRes master are displayed too brightly, while the highlights are too dark, resulting in a washed-out look. At least, that's the best way I can describe it. In any case, the colors are clearly not being displayed correctly:


Fortunately, there is a solution for this as well: View > Options... > Playback > DirectShow Video > Video Mixing Renderer 9 (renderless)
After changing this setting, the colors of the ProRes master should now be displayed correctly:
item.author: Hard Hardy
